intentions.title: Bridge the Elixir control plane to real cloud provisioning via a Go worker that drains a job queue over a poll-based (no Oban, no websocket) claim/succeed/fail protocol
intentions.evidence: worker.go package doc: '/v1/launch + /v1/go-live pay and create a provisioning row but do NOT provision — this worker does'; Worker.RunOnce implements claim → Provision → succeed/fail against /v1/internal/provision-jobs/*; WORKER_TOKEN bearer auth is a separate principal from user/agent tokens.

intentions.title: Guarantee a live box is never orphaned from the control plane and never billed silently: every failure path tears down what it created, classifying transient (5xx/timeout, retried ~60s) vs terminal (4xx, stop) control-plane report failures
intentions.evidence: worker.go RunOnce doc 'THE MONEY EDGE'; succeedWithRetry/failWithRetry/reportWithRetry with reportRetries=5 and is4xx classification; ProvisionWith's Teardown returned non-nil only on success; SweepFunc/SweepOrphans recovers boxes labeled barkpark-orphaned=true.

intentions.title: Provide a warm pool of pre-baked, continuously-freshened boxes so a go-live can assign a live instance in ≤15s instead of waiting on a cold Hetzner create, while staying billing-safe at exactly the configured pool size
intentions.evidence: warmpool.go: WarmPoolClient (Claim/ClaimForRetire/ClaimForRefresh/Register/Delete/CountReady) backed by a Postgres FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim store; tryWarmAssign/launchWarmRefill/ReconcileWarmPoolWith grow-shrink to target size; freshenWarmBox+dwb-17 fail-closed freshen before a box enters the pool; recycleStaleWarmBox rolls the pool onto the newest bake one box at a time.

intentions.title: Never declare a provisioned instance 'ready' until the golden path is proven end-to-end — not just healthy but actually loggable-into — closing the #957 class of dead-on-arrival boxes (e.g. truncated SECRET_KEY_BASE)
intentions.evidence: verify.go: three ordered probes (verify.api, verify.login with sentinel wrong creds expecting <500, verify.studio scoped-redirect walk); runVerifyGate runs after content bootstrap and before ready, tearing the box down on any red probe (same cleanup path as a content failure).

intentions.title: Bootstrap a freshly-provisioned box with real content (workspace, schemas, seed data, tokens) from a catalog template so an owner lands in a working site, not an empty box
intentions.evidence: provision.go DefaultBootstrap resolves catalog.Get(req.Template), runs bootstrap.Run with schema/seed bytes; ConsoleSink/DetailSink tee sub-step narration to the live console + curated captions (dwb-16/dwb-19); a bootstrap failure tears the box down through the same cleanup machinery as any other failure.

intentions.title: Extend provisioning to be provider-neutral (Hetzner and Azure) with honest degraded behavior on non-Hetzner kinds (no warm pool, provider-appropriate image resolution) rather than silently misapplying Hetzner assumptions
intentions.evidence: provision.go ProvisionWith 'Provider routing (charter Decision 9)': kind defaults to Hetzner for back-compat, Azure requires envAzureSSHPubKey checked BEFORE any resource is created, forces WarmPoolSize=0/WarmClient=nil off Hetzner, resolves image via cloud.ProviderFor(kind, job.Credentials).

intentions.title: Support cross-provider disaster recovery: rebuild a whole instance from a portable archive bundle onto a fresh box on either provider, preserving its prior identity (KEK carried, never minted) so links and tokens survive
intentions.evidence: restore.go RESURRECT chain (charter S14, Decision 12): RestoreDriver seam (CreateHost/Freshen/InstallSecrets/pg_restore); ResurrectStepOrder mirrors the launch step vocabulary so /new renders it identically; resurrect NEVER warm-assigns (D40); BundleRef/BundleManifest in worker.go carry Store/Key/KEK/Manifest across the worker-token channel.

intentions.title: Make graceful shutdown safe for in-flight provisions: give a running job a bounded grace window to finish, then interrupt and release its claim (no consumed attempt) rather than losing or double-running work
intentions.evidence: worker.go dwb-15 Shutdown/setInflight/clearInflight/releaseWithRetry machinery; DefaultShutdownDeadline=60s; release POST flips claimed→pending via /v1/internal/provision-jobs/:id/release with claim-fence token so a swept-and-re-claimed job's stale worker can't flip a row it lost.
